verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is code-first, so its own documented JavaScript/TypeScript API lets an agent create scenes, meshes, lights, cameras and other scene-graph nodes and edit their properties programmatically, including headlessly via NullEngine on the server side. However, nothing shows that its editor-style tools (Inspector, Playground, Node Material Editor) expose a scriptable or agent-facing control interface. There is also no evidence of build triggering, and the runtime probe found no official MCP server and no OpenAPI surface. Missing for 10: a documented scriptable interface for driving the editor tools, programmatic build/project triggering, an official agent-facing interface (MCP or API), and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven scene authoring.
